dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single prominent horizontal band of white pixels across the greater coverts, showing high contrast against the grey-green wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; distinct white linear edges along the outer webs of folded flight feathers creating a striped appearance.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast white patch on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp transition boundary between the black crown and grey mantle, interrupted by the white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent white cheek patch contrasting with black head plumage.
